items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: A.J. was with the original, uh, McNeil Southern Sync papers.

ctx.x: Well, A.J. was from here, I mentioned him to you yesterday. And he has a sister that's still playing, she's up in age, but she does it short. A.J. Johnson. Yes, Clayton Johnson was her sister. A.J. was with the original, uh, McNeil Southern Sync papers.
